title: Capstone 2: Category Share
story: Which categories earn the most, and what share of the total is that?
goal: Show category, revenue and share (revenue divided by total revenue, times 100, rounded to 1 decimal) for delivered orders, biggest first.

tests.label: Hidden check on other data

hints: A window over the groups: SUM(SUM(...)) OVER () is the grand total.

SELECT p.category, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.qty * p.price) / SUM(SUM(o.qty * p.price)) OVER (), 1) AS share FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category;
socratic: What is the total revenue across all categories?
Can a window function wrap an aggregate?
explain: In one sentence: what does this query do, and why does it need the OVER or a subquery?
solution: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.qty * p.price) / SUM(SUM(o.qty * p.price)) OVER (), 1) AS share FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category;
alt: WITH r AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(o.qty * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM r), 1) AS share FROM r ORDER BY revenue DESC, category;
